question: Which material types of vessels are enumerated in response to the goddess?
premises: A vessel made of clay is listed
A vessel of tortoise origin is listed
Vessels of bell metal and copper metal are listed
inference: The vessels enumerated include those made of clay, tortoise origin, bell metal, and copper metal
plain_english: O goddess, there are vessels made of clay, born of tortoise, made of bell metal, and born of copper metal.
